prompt: How can the woman improve the view without obstructing the route to the next booth while keeping the counter well lit?
promptZh: 女方如何改善鏡中的視野，同時不擋住通往下一間試衣間的路，又讓櫃檯保持光線充足？

options.text: Move the whole stand closer to the counter.
options.zh: 把整個鏡架移到更靠近櫃檯的地方。
options.whyZh: 男方要求鏡架留在原位，以保留通行空間；他提的改善方式是轉鏡面，不是移整座鏡架。

options.text: Close the blind next to the counter.
options.whyZh: 關上百葉窗能改善反光，但會讓櫃檯太暗。

options.text: Turn the mirror slightly and leave the stand in place.
options.zh: 稍微轉動鏡面，鏡架留在原位。
options.whyZh: 只調鏡面角度可改善反光，不占用通道，百葉窗也能維持開啟，讓櫃檯保持明亮。

options.text: Shift the stand forward and angle the mirror back.
options.zh: 把鏡架向前移，再把鏡面往回轉。
options.whyZh: 把鏡架往前移會占用大家通往下一間試衣間的空間，不符合留在原位的安排。

explanationZh: 只調鏡面角度可改善反光，不占用通道，百葉窗也能維持開啟，讓櫃檯保持明亮。
evidence: Angle the mirror a little to the left. Leave the stand where it is, though. People use the space in front of it to get to the next booth. / It would, but then the counter would be too dark. Once the mirror looks right, put one piece of tape on each side of the hinge. The evening team can line them up if someone moves it again.
